category.reason: The favorite control is identified by its position on the product immediately to the left of the highest-priced item.

instruction.en: Find the item adjacent to the left of the highest-priced item and click to add it to your favorites.
instruction.zh: 找到价格最高商品左侧相邻的商品，点击收藏。

reference.patch: Changed category.item from Reasoning to Relative Position and updated category.reason to describe the target’s position relative to the highest-priced item.
